rappel_detail.anchor: rock horn with slings and rap rings (natural, not bolted)
rappel_detail.station: The top of the exposed crux pitch on the southwest face, reached by downclimbing from the summit block to the ridge crest.
rappel_detail.notes: The one standard rappel, about 30 m on a 60 m rope doubled (or two ropes tied), back onto the southwest face gully. Then downclimb the loose gully to the base.
hazards: Very loose rock throughout; stagger the party through the gully and wear helmets.

set.rappels: One rappel of about 30 m from a slung horn at the top of the crux pitch (a 60 m rope doubled), then downclimb the loose gully; or downclimb the whole route
